name: MEDPAR Inpatient Claims for FFS Beneficiaries
description: Constructed from Medicare Provider Analysis and Review (MedPAR) files, it includes admission, discharge, diagnosis, and Medicare payment data for traditional Medicare FFS beneficiaries, joined by encrypted beneficiary ID (bene_id) with the MBSF Denominator File for FFS Beneficiaries. The data is available from 2000 to 2021.

content.adm_day_of_week: Int32: Day of Week of Admission (1=Sunday, 7=Saturday)
content.dschrgcd: String: Code identifying status of patient as of discharge date
content.admsn_type_cd: String: Admission Type Code (e.g., emergency, urgent, elective)
content.src_admsn_cd: String: Source of Admission Code (e.g., physician referral, transfer)
content.primary_diagnosis: String: Primary Diagnosis Code for Admission
content.diagnoses: List<String>: List of All Diagnosis Codes for Admission
content.non_external_primary: Int32: Flag indicating if primary diagnosis is non-external cause (1 = yes, 0 = no)
content.non_external_all: List<Int32>: Flags indicating if each diagnosis code is non-external cause
content.los_day_cnt: Int32: Length of Stay in Days
content.drg_price_amt: Double: Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) Price Amount
content.bene_blood_ddctbl_amt: Double: Blood Deductible Amount Paid by Beneficiary
content.bene_prmry_pyr_amt: Double: Beneficiary Primary Payer Amount (other insurance paid)
content.bene_pta_coinsrnc_amt: Double: Beneficiary Part A Coinsurance Amount
content.admission_year: Int32: Year of Hospital Admission (derived from admission_date)
content.admission_index: Int64: Sequential Admission Index for Beneficiary
